accepted.quote: Committee Democrats support ending the diversion of the 9/ 11 Passenger Security Fee (PSF) and ensuring Congress uses taxpayer dollars and fee revenues to make smart investments in the Transportation Security Administration's (TSA) personnel and screening technologies to keep the traveling public secure.
accepted.rationale: The legislator states support for ending the PSF diversion to invest fee revenues in TSA personnel and screening technology.

accepted.quote: Congress must ensure efforts to increase technology funding do not lead to workforce cuts and, as a result, longer passenger checkpoint wait times and degraded passenger security.
accepted.rationale: The legislator supports protecting the TSA workforce from cuts when funding technology.
